change_log.reason: v1 negative was overdetermined: taker-only economics and no intraday state at T-6h; post-hoc diagnostic showed raw model ranking separates market-identical tails 3x monotonically
change_log.change: maker-channel economics primary; out-of-fold recalibration of probability levels; intraday running max/min features at T-6h; tail-focused registered families with matched baselines; pre-committed kill condition

change_log.reason: v2.0 run: early-fold-only calibration fit starves the calibrator - the lowest bin floors at Jeffreys 0.5/(n+1) ~ 1.6%, making sub-1% thresholds structurally unreachable (3 of 5 ladder rungs empty; favorite cells unsupported at 3 events). The two reachable bands did separate monotonically out-of-fold (0.52% vs 1.31% realized)
change_log.change: walk-forward calibration: each evaluation fold's calibrated probabilities are fitted only on strictly earlier folds (middle fits on early; recent fits on early+middle); early remains in-fit and is excluded from the kill condition as before. No thresholds, bins, families, or gates changed
change_log.result_status: amendment registered after observing v2.0's empty rungs and before any v2.1 execution; v2.0 artifacts retained in git history

common_contract.execution: maker: rest at last print, maker fee only (quadratic series), hold to settlement; taker variant reported as robustness column, never a gate
common_contract.day_cluster_robustness: reported alongside for every candidate cell
common_contract.calibration: monotone bin recalibration of model_probability_yes fitted on the early (discovery) fold only, applied out-of-fold to middle and recent; bins and smoothing fixed in code before the first v2 run
common_contract.intraday: T-6h decisions additionally condition on point-in-time running daily max/min from hourly station observations (NCEI global-hourly backfill; availability = observation time + 1h transmission allowance)
common_contract.search_control: family FDR then combined correction with the structural mechanism suite; unsupported cells enter with p=1

families.hypothesis: resting NO on <=5c YES tails where the calibrated model probability is below threshold beats resting NO on all such tails
families.baseline: matched market-only baseline: all <=5c tails at the same decision label and fold; the model condition must add incremental return with positive 2-SE lower bound in every fold

families.hypothesis: resting NO at 96-99c YES (buying the 1-4c NO tail) where the calibrated model doubts the favorite by a registered margin beats doing so indiscriminately
families.baseline: matched market-only baseline: all 96-99c favorites at the same decision label and fold; incremental gate as above

kill_condition: if the calibrated model shows no monotone out-of-fold separation of realized tail rates across the registered threshold ladder (middle and recent folds), weather modeling closes and the atlas #2 target (CPI/ALFRED) moves up
